title: Redemption Value and Award Fee Tariff, Wanderlane Traveller Club
content:
This tariff states the value at which Wanderlane Traveller Club points redeem and the fees charged against an award booking already made with points. The redemption minimum is the smallest redemption permitted, in points. The redemption value is the value one point redeems at against a travel booking, in US cents. The award change fee is charged in US dollars to change an award booking already made with points, and the award cancel fee to cancel one and return the points.

## The tariff

| Basis | Blue | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Titanium | Ambassador |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Redemption minimum (points) | 5000 | 4000 | 3000 | 2000 | 1000 | 1000 |
| Redemption value (US cents for each point) | 0.8 | 0.9 | 1 | 1.15 | 1.3 | 1.5 |
| Award change fee (USD) | 95 | 75 | 50 | 25 | 0 | 0 |
| Award cancel fee (USD) | 125 | 95 | 75 | 50 | 0 | 0 |

## Notes on the tariff

The redemption minimum falls as the tier rises, from 5000 points at Wanderlane Blue to 1000 points at Wanderlane Titanium and Wanderlane Ambassador alike, while the redemption value rises over the same range, from 0.8 US cents for each point at Wanderlane Blue to 1.5 US cents at Wanderlane Ambassador.

Both award fees stand at 0 at Wanderlane Titanium and Wanderlane Ambassador. At every tier below them the cancel fee is the larger of the two: 125 against a change fee of 95 at Wanderlane Blue, 95 against 75 at Wanderlane Silver, 75 against 50 at Wanderlane Gold, and 50 against 25 at Wanderlane Platinum.
